_about: Solutions replayed by the puzzle test runner (Scripts/PuzzleResolver.gd) for URL puzzles (custom-redirects.json) and scene puzzles with no recorded solution. Built from Formspree submissions; `source` is the submitted text, `cleaned` a hand-cleaned version when the parser couldn't read it. Each step plays `card`; `picks` answers the chooser it opens ([] = nothing), `effect` answers an effect choice (heal/damage; a list for repeats, e.g. Echo + Potion), `copy` picks a Trace copy (true) or the original (false). A `skip` string excludes the puzzle and says why.
